property_summary: For every call to transfer(...) with a non-empty _tos array and a callee that reverts, the reference implementation always reverts (does not return true), whereas the mutant ignores failed external calls and thus can return true — so the property: transfer(...) either reverts (reference) or returns true only if all external calls succeed; in particular, when the callee reverts the reference will not return true but the mutant may.
change_summary: Change revert() to continue on failure (remove revert and ignore failed call) so transfer returns true even if some external calls fail, altering observable outcome.
